items.title: UK Property Data API - EPC, Comps, Council Tax, Flood Risk
items.name: uk-property-data-api
items.description: Look up any of 30 million UK homes by UPRN: price and rent estimates with gross yield, land registry sale history and tenure, EPC ratings and scores, council tax band and cost, flood and coastal risk, title and plot, broadband and mobile coverage, comparable listings and the seller disclosure pack.

address-match.eventDescription: Charged once for each UK address matched to a free text phrase or listed inside a postcode: the UPRN, the full address broken into flat, building, street, town and postcode, the local authority and dependent locality, the Ordnance Survey classification code and its description, latitude and longitude, eastings and northings, and the provider's own match score so a partial address gives you ranked candidates rather than a guess. Phrases and postcodes that match nothing are not charged.

property-record.eventDescription: Charged once for each property read in full: the address, UPRN, coordinates and grid reference, property type and classification, bedrooms, bathrooms, receptions and floor area, the model price estimate, rent estimate and gross yield alongside the land registry value and the last recorded sale price and date, tenure and title number, council tax band with its monthly and annual cost, current and potential EPC ratings and scores with the certificate number and date, flood risk from rivers and seas and from surface water, coastal erosion and conservation area status, plot area, broadband speeds at three tiers and indoor mobile coverage for four networks. UPRNs the provider does not recognise are not charged.

material-information.eventDescription: Charged once for each seller disclosure pack: tenure with lease term remaining, ground rent and its review period, service charge and deposit, construction type and whether it is non-standard, main heating, radon risk, plot size, floor level, parking and its cost and proximity, listed building and conservation status, greenbelt, area of outstanding natural beauty, national park and common land, restrictive covenants with their details, coalfield and coastal erosion flags, pylon and tree order proximity, reservoir risk on wet and dry days, flood depth bands for surface water and for rivers and seas in both the present day and future horizons, building safety, and the accessibility features. Properties with no pack are not charged.

comparable-listing.eventDescription: Charged once for each comparable listing near a property: its UPRN and full address, the price with its formatted display, property type, bedrooms and tenure, the listing status alongside the status that was asked for, the listing, withdrawal, sold subject to contract and let agreed dates, time on market, distance from the subject in miles, floor area in feet and metres, price per square foot, the listing agent, how many images and floorplans it carries, links to the listing on each portal and a street view link. Properties with no comparables in that status are not charged.

sold-comparable.eventDescription: Charged once for each completed sale recorded at the land registry near a property: the address and postcode, the registered price and the date it sold, property type, bedrooms and tenure, coordinates, distance from the subject, floor area in feet and metres, price per square foot and a street view link. These are registered transactions rather than marketing states, and they are kept in their own row type for that reason. Properties with no recorded sales nearby are not charged.

school-record.eventDescription: Charged once for each school near the property: its name, Ofsted rating, pupil count, the phases it teaches from nursery through college and whether it is private, its distance from the property and its coordinates. Properties with no school data are not charged.

transport-record.eventDescription: Charged once for each transport link near the property, flattened out of the provider's six groups so rail stations, bus stops, ferry terminals, trunk roads, airports and local connections sit in one sortable list with the group, the link name, the distance and the coordinates. Properties with no transport data are not charged.

tree-order-record.eventDescription: Charged once for each tree preservation order around the property, with its order reference, the species it protects and its coordinates. Properties with no orders nearby are not charged.

listed-building-record.eventDescription: Charged once for each listed building around the property, with its name, its listing grade and the date it was listed, and its coordinates. Properties with no listed buildings nearby are not charged.

insider-listing.eventDescription: Charged once for each property seen on the market across a postcode outcode: the address and UPRN with the provider's match confidence, the asking price, the agent, property type, listing status, bedrooms and tenure, whether it is a new build and whether it is sold subject to contract, the key features and description, when it was first scanned and submitted, the withdrawal date on the withdrawn feed, the coordinates and links to the listing on each portal. Outcodes with no listings are not charged.

items.title: UK Property Market Data API - Prices, Rents, Yields, EPC
items.name: uk-property-market-data-api
items.description: Read UK property data by postcode, coordinates, what3words or town: asking and sold prices, rents, yields, growth and demand, planning applications, listed buildings, flood risk, EPC ratings, UPRNs, title ownership and leases, sale and rental valuations, and investment sourcing lists.

market-record.eventDescription: Charged once for each local area reading: asking prices, sold prices, long let and HMO rents, rental yields, capital growth, sales and rental demand, price per square foot, estate agent market share, build and rebuild costs, flood risk, conservation area and green belt checks, crime, demographics, income, population, council tax, internet speed and property stock by type or tenure. One row is a complete answer about one area. Locations the provider holds no data for are not charged.

property-record.eventDescription: Charged once for each single property answer: a property by its UPRN with its address parts, coordinates, use class and registered leases with their remaining years, a title number matched to a UPRN, a title with its address, type, ownership and lease information, an address matched to its UPRN, and sale, rental, HMO and historical valuations with the provider's estimate, margin and confidence. Priced above an area reading because one row is about one property rather than a neighbourhood.

list-record.eventDescription: Charged once for each record in a list answer: one planning application, one listed building, one freehold title, one UPRN, one EPC rating, one known floor area, one HMO register entry, one nearby school or one sourced investment property. Priced well below an area reading because a single request commonly returns dozens of these. Requests the provider returns nothing for are not charged.

account-record.eventDescription: Charged once for reading your own provider account: credits used and credits remaining on your plan. This is free at the provider and costs no credits there, so it is priced near zero here: checking what you have left before spending it should not itself cost anything worth counting.
